introHtml: Custom hand sanitizers with carabiner keep hygiene accessible for employees and event attendees on the go. The built-in clip lets recipients attach the bottle to bags, belts, or keychains, reducing the chance of losing it. Ideal for safety managers distributing sanitizer on job sites or HR directors assembling welcome kits, these portable bottles encourage frequent use. Decorate the clear bottle with your logo using screen printing or a full-color label to reinforce brand visibility wherever the sanitizer goes.
